# Huntly

> Huntly makes technology that points children outward — real-world outdoor adventures for curious kids aged 4-14. No ads, no in-app purchases. Two products: the Huntly quest app and Huntly World, the seasonal adventure club. Built by Fluff Software in Swindon, UK.

## Products

- [Huntly](https://huntly.world/huntly-app): The outdoor adventure app for kids — bite-size GPS-guided quests that send children hunting for shapes, wildlife and wonder in nature.
- [Huntly World](https://huntly.world/huntly-world): A story-driven seasonal adventure club for children aged 4-14. Weekly outdoor missions, three team captains (Bears, Foxes, Otters), badges and achievements.

## For attractions and businesses

- [Partners](https://huntly.world/partners): Bespoke GPS-guided quest experiences for outdoor attractions (farms, tourist sites) — no hardware, done-for-you setup, repeat visits and a new revenue stream.
